newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS chief says no plans for alliances.
newsitem.headline: MAS chief says no plans for alliances.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd's (MAS) major shareholder and chairman Tajuddin Ramli on Thursday denied speculation that he was taking on a partner in the national airline.
"No, not that I know of," he said when asked if there was going to be a major investor in MAS apart from him.

He declined to comment on whether he was planning any strategic alliances in MAS. "Let's leave that (subject) out," he told reporters after a signing ceremony between a fibre optic cable company and the national power utility, Tenaga Nasional.
The MAS chairman controls 32 percent of MAS's equity through his majority-owned Malaysian Helicopter Services Bhd. MAS was acquired under a government privatisation programme.
Tajuddin also confirmed that he planned to increase his group's stake in MAS to 51 percent in 30 months from now.
